items.source_en:
Something went wrong with the Hyperdrive. I've never seen the Planck mapping take that long, and it was stuck in a loop until I diverted all power to the drive.

I should've realized it was busted and just ran a diagnostic, but I decided to punch through.

So instead of jumping to Sol like we planned, we landed in the middle of an asteroid field. I managed to steer us out of it, but we took some heavy damage. 

Damn. This is on me.
items.legacy_ko:
하이퍼드라이브에 문제가 생겼어. 플랑크 매핑이 그렇게 오래 걸리는 건 처음 봤는데, 드라이브에 모든 전력을 돌릴 때까지 루프에 빠져 있었지.

고장 난 걸 진작 알아차리고 진단 프로그램을 돌렸어야 했는데, 그냥 밀어붙이기로 결정한 게 화근이었어.

결국 계획했던 솔(Sol)로 점프하는 대신 소행성 한복판에 처박히고 말았지. 간신히 빠져나오긴 했지만, 배가 심각하게 손상됐어.

items.source_en:
Date: 5-28-2324
Codename: CAPS 
Location: Coruscant
Operator: Dr. Joseph Leonard

Success!

I have reached Coruscant without any trouble at all. CAPS works like a dream. All readings were normal, exactly as predicted. I don't have to so much as lift a finger to travel anywhere I want. It even took me down to the Imperial Center spaceport and I was able to treat myself to a fine lunch.

I sent the initial report to Linda; this is going to change everything for us.

The next test is to do a multi-jump voyage; I've selected Geonosis as my destination. Will be nice to wave farewell to those morons at Sienar Technologies as I push them into obscurity.
